precondition: top-level and nested/local PDF line paths share scoped Butt=0, Round=1, Square=2 semantics and omit default Butt 0 J

variants.transform: omit 1 J for Round in one path
emit 1 J instead of 2 J for Square
apply cap mapping only to top-level lines and omit it for local/nested lines
emit J outside the line q/Q graphics-state scope
emit 0 J for legacy Butt even when the default state suffices

validity: Each variant must be killed in both path/scoping semantics where applicable; redundant 0 J is killed by deterministic legacy Butt bytes and explicit omission.
